item.title: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas Advises Consortium of Lenders Led by Standard Chartered Bank on Transmission Project Financing
item.description: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas advised a consortium of lenders led by Standard Chartered Bank on INR 2,623.20 crore project financing for Rajgarh Neemuch Power Transmission Limited’s renewable transmission project in Madhya Pradesh. The post Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas Advises Consortium of Lenders Led by Standard Chartered Bank on Transmission Project Financing appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: AIBE XXI Announced: BCI Notifies Syllabus and Examination Schedule

item.title: Summoning order under Section 138 NI Act need not be elaborate, but must reflect application of mind: Delhi High Court
item.description: “Issuance of summons in a criminal case is a very serious matter, since even mere issuance of summons by criminal court may stigmatise a person, who may not be required to be summonsed at all.” The post Summoning order under Section 138 NI Act need not be elaborate, but must reflect application of mind: Delhi High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: “Form of oppression against girls”: Chhattisgarh HC flags lack of girls’ toilets in government schools, seeks response from School Education Secretary
item.description: “There is not even washrooms or toilets for female students, making it difficult for them to spend even five to six hours in school. This system is a form of oppression against girls. This could be a major reason for many female students dropping out or not attending school at all.” The post “Form of oppression against girls”: Chhattisgarh HC flags lack of girls’ toilets in government schools, seeks response from School Education Secretary appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Issue of genuineness of arbitration agreement be decided by Arbitrator as preliminary issue under Section 11(6A): Supreme Court

item.title: Delhi High Court restrains imitation of Manforce advertisements; Directs removal of deceptively similar promotional content
item.description: “A comparison of the original artistic works of the plaintiff posted on Instagram with that of the infringing works of Defendants1 and 2 posted on Instagram clearly depicts, prima facie, infringement of the copyrights of the plaintiff.” The post Delhi High Court restrains imitation of Manforce advertisements; Directs removal of deceptively similar promotional content appeared first on SCC Times.
